dictionary.title: Bluetooth
dictionary.description: Any wireless device: speakers, headphones, microphones, mice, keyboards, joysticks and controllers
dictionary.notice_unpaired: This node is visible in the mesh but not paired: pair it to manage its Bluetooth.
dictionary.notice_paired_present: The node has a Bluetooth adapter: devices are paired from the node itself.
dictionary.notice_paired_absent: The node has not reported any Bluetooth adapter.
dictionary.unreachable: The Bluetooth service is not responding: retrying automatically.
dictionary.notice_disabled: The Bluetooth service is disabled in the system settings.
dictionary.notice_absent: Plug in a USB Bluetooth adapter: it will be configured automatically.
dictionary.scan_hint: Put the device in pairing mode (usually by holding its Bluetooth or power button) and start the search.
dictionary.power_hint: Turn the radio on to search for and connect devices.
dictionary.settings_live: Changes apply immediately, including the main screen and ongoing conversations.
dictionary.pair_hint: After pairing, the device is trusted and connected.
dictionary.forget_body: {name} will be removed with its settings and will need to be paired again.
dictionary.group_audio_out_hint: How to use the device for listening
dictionary.group_audio_in_hint: How to use the device to talk with {assistant}
dictionary.setting_autoconnect_hint: Try to connect it when it is on and nearby.
dictionary.setting_output_use_hint: Preferred: audio moves here as soon as it connects. Never: not used for listening.
dictionary.setting_volume_hint: Level set when it becomes the active output.
dictionary.setting_profile_hint: High quality turns the microphone off; headset keeps it always on.
dictionary.setting_voice_input_hint: Preferred: it becomes the microphone you use to talk with {assistant}, immediately on the main screen too.
dictionary.setting_mic_gain_hint: Input level set when it becomes the active microphone.
dictionary.setting_pointer_speed_hint: Pointer acceleration on the main screen.
dictionary.setting_natural_scroll_hint: Content follows the movement of your fingers or wheel.
dictionary.setting_games_enabled_hint: Makes the controller available to live games with {assistant}.
dictionary.setting_sensitivity_hint: Higher values respond sooner, useful in driving games.
dictionary.setting_invert_y_hint: Stick up and down are swapped.
dictionary.setting_vibration_hint: Lets games make the controller vibrate.
dictionary.pref_auto_switch_hint: Moves audio and microphone to a device as soon as it connects, by priority.
dictionary.pref_announce_hint: Shows a notification when a device connects.
dictionary.priority_hint: With several devices connected the preferred one wins, then the first in the list.
dictionary.paired_empty: No paired device: start a search to add one.
dictionary.nearby_empty: Start a search to find new devices.
dictionary.nearby_searching: Looking for devices in pairing mode…
